fewShots.question: is there any anomaly right now?
fewShots.query:
machinesraw_normalized
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by machine_id, attribute_name
| join kind=inner external_table('machineparameters') on $left.machine_id==$right.machine_id and $left.attribute_name==$right.attribute_name
| extend anomaly = iff(attribute_value_decimal >= min_value and attribute_value_decimal <= max_value, false, true)
| where anomaly == true
| project machine_id, attribute_name, timestamp, attribute_value_decimal, anomaly, max_value, min_value
